verdict.rationale: Agent wallet custody is a fair question for a stablecoin platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack does not document programmatic wallet issuance for agents, scoped agent keys, policy controls, or limits on what an agent can move. The closest items do not qualify: machine payments and x402 are about merchants accepting agent payments, and stablecoin Financial Accounts are business balances, not agent wallets. Both are adjacent features and earn no credit.
